packageRules.description: Group Spring ecosystem updates into a single PR
Group Kotlin-related updates into a single PR
engines declares the minimum supported runtime; raising it would exclude users, so never bump it automatically
Wiki majors (VitePress pins vite ^5, mermaid 12 needs a deliberate migration) wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard
Look up Maven artifacts in the public repositories the build resolves from; the publishing repositories (GitHub Packages, Linyi) need credentials Renovate does not have and only add 401s
JDK 17 is the supported baseline the workflows build and test on; newer JDKs are covered by the dedicated JDK 25 test job, so never bump the major automatically
